The plugin acts on a RevealJS deck, so an example cannot run on this page.
Each page below shows the YAML you write and says what it does.
The [preview deck](preview.html) is where you try the result.

## Nothing at all

```yaml
format:
  revealjs:
    revealjs-plugins:
      - a11y
```

Enabling the plugin alone gives the skip link, the focus indicators, the zoomable viewport, reduced-motion support, the font and spacing controls, underlined links, slide landmarks, the announcements, the transcript, the visual slide change cue, the screen-reader fixes for the bundled menu, and the settings menu on <kbd>A</kbd>.

The pointer indicator, high contrast, the audio cue, and the alt text warnings are the four that start off.
